$description: TKC design tokens. Each leaf has a 'value'; its CSS custom property is '--tkc-' + path joined by '-' (without the top-level group name), see css field. Colours: 'value' is the CSS colour (oklch with the brand hue variable), 'hex' is the resolved sRGB value at the default brand hue, used for contrast checks and for engines without oklch.

$meta.densitySelector: [data-density="compact"|"comfortable"] (default compact on pointer:fine, comfortable on pointer:coarse)
$meta.status: APPROVED (SUITE-180, 2026-11-21): primary hue 195; brand pink #e95295 for the logo only (--tkc-logo); never text

sans.value: "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

mono.value: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

$notes.aliasing: Semantic values reference primitives as {primitive.color.<ramp>.<step>}. The generator resolves them to var(--tkc-color-<ramp>-<step>).
$notes.legacyDawn: Same property names are emitted for the Dawn override; Dawn rules map selectors to var(--tkc-*).
